clips.title: The story
paras: Deep within the hostile briars of Razorfen Kraul, a dying night elf named Heralath Fallowbrook whispers his final plea to passing Alliance adventurers. Stripped of his strength and life, he asks only that his wife's stolen pendant of bonding be recovered and brought home to Darnassus alongside news of his demise.

Razorfen Kraul is a perilous redoubt overrun by savage quilboar and dark magic, far from Alliance territory. Among these treacherous brambles lies Heralath Fallowbrook, mortally wounded and fading fast. With his dying strength, he manages only broken whispers, revealing that a brave dwarf named Lonebrow was sent ahead to deliver a warning to Falfindel. Heralath, however, knows he will never leave the Kraul alive.

Before succumbing to his wounds, Heralath clings to one final wish: retrieving a token of his marriage. A pendant symbolizing his eternal bond with his wife, Treshala, was torn from him by one of the lair's foul aggressors. He begs any traveler who stops beside him to recover the pendant and carry it all the way across Kalimdor to Darnassus, ensuring Treshala learns the truth of his lonely death rather than waiting in vain.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I have not long to live... So... So... Weak.
...the b-b-brave dwarf, Lonebrow, has been sent to w-w-warn Falfindel...
...my wife, Treshala... Her pendant of bonding to me... Stolen... By one of the f-f-foul aggressors...
Find it p-p-please... And return it to Treshala in Darnassus...
...along with w-w-word of my lonely... Death.

clips.title: Progress
paras: What brings you to my home, traveler?

clips.title: Completion
paras: 'Tis not fair. Oh, cruel and intolerable world!
I must now carry this burden of grief and not let Heralath's work die with him.
You were brave to journey from such a dangerous place, friend. But please leave me now.
